mike_sales: Quick help needed — AtlasHealth POC seeing intermittent 429s during a live demo. They hit about 30 concurrent embedding requests with batch size 16. Anyone can triage?

anya_se: What model/route and tokens per item? Paste request/response headers if possible.

mike_sales: Sent sanitized curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-compat-large","input":[...16 items...]}'
Response: {"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","code":429}} HTTP/1.1 429 Retry-After: 3 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
They estimated ~2k tokens per item so ~32k tokens/request * concurrency spikes.

ram_engineer: That matches tenant burst window exhaustion. We log bucket decisions like: rate_limit:tenant=atlashealth,route=/v1/embeddings,bucket=burst,allowed=0. Can you fetch proxy logs?

mike_sales: Client logs show: POST 200 tokens=32000 then two POST 429 tokens=32000 rate_limit=tenant_burst

infra_pete: Confirms per-tenant short burst window (60s) got exhausted. Options: temporary demo bump or ask client to reduce concurrency/batch.

lisa_account_mgr: If we bump, customer needs cost/duration. Sales propose numbers.

ram_engineer: Recommend immediate client fixes: batch=4, concurrency=8, exponential backoff honoring Retry-After. Also suggest smaller embed model fallback. Example snippet provided.

mike_sales: They'll change client. Requesting temporary +50k burst tokens for 1 hour to avoid demo failure. They have LOA.

ram_engineer: +50k for 1 hour sounds safe. infra_pete, can you apply?

infra_pete: Applying +50000 burst_tokens to tenant atlashealth until 2026-03-21T16:10:30Z. Posting audit id shortly.

sre_bot: Automated audit - quota change applied: tenant=atlashealth change=+50000 type=burst expires=1700531430 audit_id=QTR-20260321-7782

lisa_account_mgr: I'll follow up on billing note (minimal) and confirm LOA.

mike_sales: Customer reran and reported no 429s for 20+ minutes during the demo. We'll still push client changes to prevent recurrence.

anya_se: Please add client concurrency guidance to the POC playbook and note batch recommendations per embed model.

ram_engineer: Filed a short tech note with batch-size/expected-tokens heuristics for demo runners.

mike_sales: Closing out unless objections.

infra_pete: +1

lisa_account_mgr: +1

mike_sales: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
